alt: One ribbon path crossing four hills, with a young tree on the last one.
prompt: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background. Four low hills made of flat faceted paper stand in a row from the lower left to the upper right, each a little higher than the one before. One continuous wide satin ribbon, in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan, runs across all four hills like a path, catching the light on each crest, and carries on out of frame at the upper right: four steps that keep going. A young faceted paper sapling stands on the last and highest hill. Soft slate-blue shadows, Partner Navy only in the deepest facets, a pale Daylight sky with calm empty space in the upper left quarter. Aspect about 1.08:1, safe to crop to 4:5. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right.
